subject: WAIC when using "ar1" model for residuals

messages.author: 34560e4cfcedfadd
messages.subject: WAIC when using "ar1" model for residuals
parts:
I've the following model for a non-linear mean with auto-correlated residuals:

formula_ar <- y ~ f(x.mu, model="rw2") + f(x.res, model="ar1")

result_ar <- inla(formula_ar,
                   data=list(x.mu = x, x.res = x, y = y),
                   family = "gaussian",
                   control.family = list(hyper = list(prec = list(initial = 15, fixed = TRUE))),
                   control.compute = list(waic=TRUE))

When I compute the WAIC it is much lower than expected. This I determined by comparing the WAIC for a model with gaussian residuals fit to data with uncorrelated residuals, where WAIC is expected to be similar. Is there some way to configure the model so that "ar1" is understood to model residual structure rather than the mean?

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] WAIC when using "ar1" model for residuals
parts:
For the moment, its not possible to define that the AR1 should model
the residual rather than the latent effect.

when doing this trick, moving the data into the linear predictor, the
DIC and WAIC does not give meaning results....

H
